description: Renewable generation and electricity consumption dataset for energy market models generated with artificial intelligence, published by Biró, Bence; Mayer, Martin János; Szücs, Botond; Aszódi, Attila, provides neural-network-derived renewable capacity factors and electricity consumption trained on ERA5 and ENTSO-E. Coverage: European countries with sufficient training data; hourly 1981-2023 series. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: These are model-generated series; country inclusion depends on training-data sufficiency and no independent quality check was performed. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
